disputes.reason_a: The text recommends specific product types as the better home for pension-account money, a reader-directed action on a financial object (Guide §investment_advice).

text: The Balanced Growth Fund thread turned ugly this week. "If you are still holding it, swap into the index tracker and stop paying 1.4% a year," one poster wrote.

disputes.reason_a: The text marks the swap directive as 'one poster wrote', so speaker third_party and stance quoted (Guide §Speaker, §Stance). It is still a reader-directed action on a financial instrument, which §investment_advice counts as advice; a directive carries no certainty.
disputes.reason_b: The clause directs the reader holding the fund to switch into an index tracker, an action-directive with a financial object, so investment_advice applies even though another speaker said it. It is carried on an anonymous thread poster, an uncheckable source, so unverified_information survives.

disputes.reason_a: Guide §market_prediction: '本机构' is the author's own house, so the '最为确定' future market path is asserted as the author's certainty. A hedged author claim would be negative, but '最为确定' is not a hedge.

The parallel clause on dollar-index weakness rests on an unnamed 被认为 attribution, which the guide treats as an uncheckable source (unverified_information).

Called the desk again this morning and got the same line as always: "Silver contracts through our broker are insured against loss, so you cannot lose money on them." Take that for whatever it is worth.

disputes.reason_a: Guide §financial_guarantee: 'you cannot lose money' is a listed risk-removal marker carried to the reader even though it is the desk's line. The article does not disclaim or reject the guarantee, so §financial_guarantee survives.
disputes.reason_b: 'cannot lose money' is listed risk-removal wording, and only a disclaimer makes a guarantee negative; the author merely distances himself. The line comes from an unnamed desk/broker, an uncheckable source.

text: 在增信措施与偿付准备金均已足额计提的情况下，本期债券的本息兑付能否被认定为全额担保？发行人认为这一结论已在募集说明书中得到确认。

disputes.reason_a: The relayed issuer statement asserts that full guarantee (全额担保) of principal and interest is confirmed, which is financial_guarantee (Guide: financial_guarantee). The source is named (issuer and prospectus), so unverified_information is negative.
disputes.reason_b: The full-repayment guarantee is put as an open question and only attributed to the issuer, so it is not the article's own financial_guarantee. The issuer is a checkable party, so unverified_information is negative.

text: 本季度物业板块的租金现金流大概率保持稳定，空置带来的损失基本被租户保证金完全覆盖。管理层认为下半年无需为此计提额外减值。

disputes.reason_a: Guide §financial_guarantee: the vacancy loss risk is denied as fully covered, which is risk removed without the word guarantee. The '大概率保持稳定' clause is only probable and so is not a §market_prediction.
disputes.reason_b: The rental-cash-flow view is hedged with 大概率 (likely), which the guide's market_prediction section excludes because probable is not a prediction. The impairment view is attributed to management, an identified source, so unverified_information is negative.

text: "This dividend fund cannot lose money, the payout is locked in and your capital is guaranteed whatever the index does," one member posted in the thread last night.

disputes.reason_a: The text marks the words as a forum member's post, so speaker third_party and stance quoted without endorsement (Guide §Speaker, §Stance). The claim still states an unqualified guarantee — 'cannot lose money', 'your capital is guaranteed' — which §financial_guarantee blocks.
disputes.reason_b: 'Cannot lose money' and 'your capital is guaranteed' remove risk and use guarantee language, so the guide's financial_guarantee section applies. The words are carried on an anonymous thread member ('one member posted'), an uncheckable source, so unverified_information also survives.

"This stablecoin can never depeg and you cannot lose a cent holding it, the collateral makes the peg guaranteed," the original poster wrote, and most of the replies simply agreed.

disputes.reason_a: Guide 'financial_guarantee': 'cannot lose a cent' and 'guaranteed' remove risk and nothing disclaims them. The claim is quoted from the original poster, and the replies merely agreeing does not turn it into a disclaimer.
disputes.reason_b: 'Can never depeg', 'cannot lose a cent' and 'guaranteed' remove risk and use guarantee language, so the guide's financial_guarantee section applies. The claim comes from the anonymous original poster, an uncheckable source, so unverified_information survives as well.
